differences.what: A module, exam_neck, that the General note type includes: its section Neck / thyroid shows only while Neck / Thyroid (exam.systems is neck_thyroid) is picked in the exam picker, and offers one-tap Normal.

differences.what: Neck is choose-many. Supple is the normal option and is not exclusive: a supple neck is charted with tenderness, a mass, lymphadenopathy or JVD beside it, and only Stiff, its opposite, is excluded. It is not linked to Lymphatic or Cardiovascular.
differences.why: focused-exam inventory default 13, 17, 26, 48 (a reading of default 13, as for Moist: Supple describes the neck's movement, not every finding); PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #23): the clinical team confirms which normal options are held beside a finding

Carotids is choose-many, recorded for the right and the left (sides). Normal is the normal option and clears the others.
